scope: Pre-outcome input audit and simulation contract for Workstream 04. This file does not set the v2 sample size, sampling seed, strata, model, threshold, or outcome-review permission.
binding_rule: A numerical power-and-cost simulation may be run only after every required decision input below has a recorded value, decision owner, dated rationale, and pre-outcome freeze. A target or seed is not frozen by this contract.

primary_estimand.name: incremental_brier_improvement
primary_estimand.definition: Brier(active_control) minus Brier(full_automatic_evidence_model) on identical confirmation rows; a positive value favors the full model.
primary_estimand.uncertainty_requirement: Graph-aware resampling using a pre-specified cluster unit. Duplicate directions and shared images must not be treated as independent.

required_choices: superiority with a minimum practical increment
noninferiority with a separately stated margin

minimum_practical_brier_increment.rule: Must be strictly positive if superiority is selected, stated before outcome review, and justified as practically meaningful rather than chosen from v2 labels.

outcome_prevalence.rule: Historical v1 reviewability rates may define sensitivity scenarios only. They are not v2 confirmation evidence, an expected v2 effect, or a calibration target.
outcome_prevalence.required_pre_freeze_decision: Specify the deployment-queue prevalence scenarios and the rationale for each without accessing v2 outcomes.

dependence_and_graph_structure.known_pre_outcome_fact: The frozen eligible graph has 3,000 images, 85,182 canonical unordered pairs, one connected component, and image degree range 24 to 183.
dependence_and_graph_structure.rule: The simulation must stress plausible shared-image dependence and cannot assume 1,200 independent rows. The final resampling cluster unit must be declared before confirmation is opened.
dependence_and_graph_structure.required_pre_freeze_decision: Choose and justify the cluster-aware simulation/resampling method and sensitivity range.

missingness_and_completion.automatic_feature_context: Retained automatic quality candidates and local-match coverage were complete in the outcome-free pilot; excluded animal coverage is not a primary automatic feature.
required_inputs: first-pass reviewer nonresponse or invalid-response reserve
rule that every first-pass disagreement receives conflict-free third-person adjudication
analysis treatment for any later automatic-feature missingness
missingness_and_completion.rule: Pilot completeness is not permission to assume zero missingness in the 1,200-pair collection. All reserves must be selected before outcome review.

required_inputs: two different independent first-pass reviewers for every prepared pair
one eligible third-person adjudicator for every possible disagreement
reviewer and adjudicator blinding and access-control rules
immutable fields for reporting actual elapsed time and adjudication after execution
workload_and_cost.rule: The experimental design does not estimate reviewer minutes, an adjudication probability, a total-hour budget, or a collection window. Actual elapsed time and adjudication frequency are descriptive operational results recorded after execution and are not model inputs or packet-release thresholds.

sampling_constraints.non_overlap_rule: Mechanism and deployment samples must not share a canonical unordered pair. The separate 160-pair outcome-free pilot remains excluded.
sampling_constraints.target_change_rule: Any increase or reduction must occur before outcome review and be justified by the completed, dated simulation; it cannot be based on a selective observed outcome.

required_before_any_official_target_or_s: conflict-free reviewer and adjudicator role-assignment rule
completed simulation artifact with source hashes
project-owner acceptance recorded before v2 outcome review
prohibited_shortcuts: using a v1 effect size as a v2 expected effect or pass threshold
using v2 outcome labels to choose any numerical input
treating directed descriptor memberships as independent pairs
using targeted mechanism prevalence as deployment prevalence
claiming v2_design_locked from this pre-simulation contract
